label: Live_screw_driver
info:
SIE Screw Driver → POST PMS /api/machines/telemetry.

ECONNREFUSED = Node-RED host cannot TCP-connect to PMS_BASE.
Fix: on the Node-RED/Edge box run:
  curl http://192.168.1.216:8010/health
If that fails, PMS IP is wrong from Edge, or firewall/routing blocks :8010.

Same PC as PMS → use http://127.0.0.1:8010
Edge on LAN   → use http://<PMS-Ethernet-IP>:8010
